summary: VEHIQ Iteration 4 round 2 testing complete. Backend: 14/14 NEW iter5 tests PASS (active_listing attachment, share endpoint with all 4 platforms + invalid + anonymous, mark-sold owner/non-owner/unauth/default-date, P&L profit + loss). Frontend: admin routing fix verified for all 10 sections (dashboard, users, vehicles, marketplace, forum, legal, content, settings, analytics, api-keys, security) — every URL is /gv91-admin/{section} and shows correct content. End-to-end Sell→Mark-sold flow on VehicleProfile works: vehicle-sell-btn (no listing), sell-confirm-modal with sell-cancel/sell-create-listing, navigation to /marketplace/new?vehicle={id} with prefilled make/model/year, vehicle-mark-sold-btn (with listing), vehicle-for-sale-badge next to title, mark-sold-modal with mark-sold-price/date/confirm and today-default date, sold-banner + confetti-canvas + sold-net-result showing '+60,000 PLN ✅' (profit) and matching P&L on archived garage card vehicle-pl-{id}. Garage tabs garage-tabs/garage-tab-active/garage-tab-archive all render. Public vehicle page social-share-copy/facebook/twitter/whatsapp all present.

ui_bugs.issue: garage-tab-archive shows 'Archive ' (trailing space, no count) when archive count is 0. Spec says 'counts in parens'. Active tab also shows 'Active ' with no parens when count is 0 after the only vehicle was archived. Cosmetic — count is shown when >0 ('Active (1)', 'Archive (1)') but missing when 0.

issues: WhatsApp button correctly hidden on desktop via md:hidden — visible only <768px viewport. Verified by screenshot. Copy/Facebook/X all visible.

action_items: Optional polish: show '(0)' for empty Active/Archive tabs to match spec phrasing 'counts in parens' (currently only renders count when >0).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/vehicles/{id}/mark-sold for non-owner correctly returns 404 (filtered by user_id) which is the safest behavior — same shape as 'vehicle not found' so it doesn't leak ownership info.

Mark-sold is idempotent in effect: calling it on an already archived vehicle would still update sale_price/sale_date and return new net_result. Consider guarding to prevent accidental overwrite of an existing sale_price (e.g. if status==archived and sale_price set, return 400). Not critical.
active_listing on /api/vehicles list query uses a proper index-friendly $in lookup against db.listings — efficient.
ShareIn validates platform server-side AND has client-side filtering — defense-in-depth is good. Anonymous shares (user=None) are accepted — intentional per docstring.

VehicleProfile route is /garage/:id NOT /vehicles/:id — testing agent in iter4 was unaware. Document this in test_credentials.md or routing notes for future iterations to avoid confusion: /vehicles/:slug = PublicVehicle (read-only), /garage/:id = VehicleProfile (owner edit/manage).
